# FreedomBot.ai

> FreedomBot.ai is an algorithmic crypto trading platform where every trade is recorded on-chain for public verification. Deploy a bot on Bybit (and other supported exchanges) in under five minutes. No upfront fees — you keep control of your exchange API keys.

Not: FNONINJA / FNO Ninja (NSE F&O option-chain analytics — separate product at https://fnoninja.com/).

## About

- [Homepage](https://freedombot.ai/): Product overview, transparency promise, and deploy flow
- [About](https://freedombot.ai/about): Team and mission
- [Methodology](https://freedombot.ai/methodology): Rule-based playbook — entries, stops, sizing, leverage

## Public data

- [Live records](https://freedombot.ai/records): On-chain verifiable trade history (Solana-backed ledger)
- [Performance](https://freedombot.ai/performance): Equity curve, monthly returns, and risk metrics for public bots

## How it works

1. **Sign in** — Google sign-in; no credit card required to explore.
2. **Deploy** — Choose a bot and connect exchange API keys (read/trade permissions you control).
3. **Verify** — Every closed trade is published on-chain; anyone can audit results on the records page.

## Key features

- **On-chain transparency** — Trade entries, exits, and PnL recorded on Solana for independent verification
- **User-owned keys** — API credentials stay with you; FreedomBot does not custody funds
- **Rule-based automation** — Documented stop-loss, position sizing, and market filters (see methodology)
- **Multi-bot discovery** — BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP zone bots and more on supported perp exchanges
